versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.11

- Improved handling for transparent image cards: preserves PNG/WebP alpha and ensures cutout images display cleanly on black backgrounds.
- Boards with text-only or detailed image cards now skip unnecessary AI vision steps; labels are derived directly from available data.
- Clear guidance added for unpublished TierVibe posts and for boards requiring AI vision capabilities that may be unavailable.
- Enhanced high-resolution board capture: background is generated via an automated, client-side action without additional TierVibe server calls.
- Updated instructions for workflow steps, including precise criteria for when vision is and isn't needed.

TierList Video Maker 1.0.10

- Clarified support for both text and image cards, detailing when vision (image recognition) is and isn’t required.
- Improved documentation for transparent image handling and video background composition.
- Added clear guidance about requiring published TierVibe posts (drafts/edits unsupported).
- Provided specific user-facing messages for unsupported cases and missing vision capability.
- Expanded workflow details, including steps for high-resolution board capture, fallback handling, and narration labeling.
- Emphasized accurate, per-card processing and vision-free completion paths where possible.

- Improved documentation in SKILL.md with detailed usage instructions, including requirements for published TierVibe posts and clear handling for different card types (text, image with/without details).
- Explicit guidance on when vision is/is not required: supports skipping AI vision steps for text cards and image cards with explanatory text, helping non-multimodal models operate effectively.
- Added user-facing troubleshooting info: clear messages when the skill cannot proceed due to unpublished posts or required multimodal capabilities.
- Enhanced description of board image capture workflow, fallback options, and model responsibilities to prevent misuse or hallucinations.
- No functional code changes are indicated—this update focuses on clarity, user support, and documentation robustness.

- Added detailed instructions and workflow for turning a published TierVibe tier list into a narrated video with a high-resolution scrolling background.
- Clarified the requirement to use only published posts; drafts or editor URLs are not supported.
- Documented support for both text and image card boards, including how to handle each and when to use AI vision.
- Provided explicit instructions for capturing high-resolution board images, including fallbacks if necessary.
- Outlined a multi-step process for board recognition, card identification, reconciliation, and narration script generation.
- Included trigger phrases for invoking the skill in multiple languages.

**Initial release of TierList Video Maker — turn a published TierVibe tier list into a narrated video.**

- Capture a high-resolution snapshot of any published TierVibe board—used as the visual background.
- Fetch all data and images from a public TierVibe URL; skip if still in draft.
- Identify card labels using either built-in text (for text cards) or AI vision (for image cards).
- Generate a narration script, produce TTS audio with subtitles, and compose a video where each card is enlarged as it’s explained.
- Includes scripts for every step: board/image retrieval, vision-based recognition, narration/TTS, and video assembly.

TierList Video Maker 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Converts any published TierVibe tier list into a narrated, high-resolution video with scrolling background.
- Fetches tier list data and card images from a public TierVibe post; automates board image capture using Playwright (no server call).
- Requires image recognition to accurately identify each card and generate narration; informs users if image recognition is unsupported.
- Ensures only published TierVibe lists are accepted (drafts/edits not supported).
- Produces user-reviewable narration scripts, TTS audio with subtitles, and composes a video with enlarged card highlights.
- Supports triggers in English and Chinese for tier list video creation.
